key: HARDY: I s'pose this is some kinda service entrance, huh?
en: HARDY: I s'pose this is some kinda service entrance, huh?
ja: ハーディ: ここ、なんかの業務用出入り口ってとこか?

key: Prolly an elevator shaft from the look of it.
en: Prolly an elevator shaft from the look of it.
ja: 見た感じ、多分エレベーターの通路だな。

key: HARDY: Let's see if we can't jimmy this bad boy open...
en: HARDY: Let's see if we can't jimmy this bad boy open...
ja: ハーディ: こいつをこじ開けられるか試してみるか……

key: HARDY: No dice, huh?
en: HARDY: No dice, huh?
ja: ハーディ: だめか?

key: Aite, in that case we've got a special technique for these kinds of situations.
en: Aite, in that case we've got a special technique for these kinds of situations.
ja: よし、それならこういう時のための特別な技があるぜ。

key: Watch closely, mate. I don't show this kind of ability to just anyone.
en: Watch closely, mate. I don't show this kind of ability to just anyone.
ja: よく見とけよ、相棒。こんな腕前、誰にでも見せるわけじゃねえんだ。

key: HARDY: See? Works every time.
en: HARDY: See? Works every time.
ja: ハーディ: な? いつだって効くんだよ。

key: HARDY: There ain' nothin' a bit of scrap metal can do against the sheer force of the human will.
en: HARDY: There ain' nothin' a bit of scrap metal can do against the sheer force of the human will.
ja: ハーディ: ちょっとした金属くずなんて、人間の意志の力にゃかなわねえのさ。

key: Same goes for just about everything.
en: Same goes for just about everything.
ja: だいたい何にでも言えることだけどな。

key: Now let's get this show on the road!
en: Now let's get this show on the road!
ja: さあ、始めるとするか!

key: HARDY: Right, so let's see what we've got.
en: HARDY: Right, so let's see what we've got.
ja: ハーディ: よし、何があるか見てみるか。

key: HARDY: Only two floors in this place, seems.
en: HARDY: Only two floors in this place, seems.
ja: ハーディ: ここ、フロアは二つしかないみたいだな。

key: And we're on the second right now.
en: And we're on the second right now.
ja: で、今いるのが2階だ。

key: Works for me. That's less we had to climb down.
en: Works for me. That's less we had to climb down.
ja: 別にいいけどよ。降りる分が少なくて済むしな。

key: HARDY: So, let's find Team Meteor and put an end to whatever they've got going here!
en: HARDY: So, let's find Team Meteor and put an end to whatever they've got going here!
ja: ハーディ: よし、チームメテオを見つけて、こいつをぶっ潰そうぜ!

key: ???: And so they come, like moths to the flame...
en: ???: And so they come, like moths to the flame...
ja: ???: かくして、彼らはやってくる、灯火に群がるガのように……

key: ???: ...or at least, that's what I would say if that hackneyed phrase weren't so grotesquely misused.
en: ???: ...or at least, that's what I would say if that hackneyed phrase weren't so grotesquely misused.
ja: ???: ……とでも言うところだが、その使い古された言い回しがあまりにも見当違いに使われているのでね。

key: Moths are night-loving creatures; there's no reason they should be attracted to light.
en: Moths are night-loving creatures; there's no reason they should be attracted to light.
ja: ガは夜を好む生き物だ。光に引き寄せられる理由などない。

key: Indeed, even when they fly near candles, it is not because they desire to be close to the light.
en: Indeed, even when they fly near candles, it is not because they desire to be close to the light.
ja: 実際、ろうそくの近くを飛ぶときですら、光の近くにいたいからではないのだよ。

key: On the contrary, the most popular theories suggest that they are, in their own way, fleeing it.
en: On the contrary, the most popular theories suggest that they are, in their own way, fleeing it.
ja: むしろ、有力な説によれば、彼らは彼らなりに、光から逃げているというわけだ。

key: All bodies of light have a slight band of darkness around them. Humans can see it too, though we often do not notice.
en: All bodies of light have a slight band of darkness around them. Humans can see it too, though we often do not notice.
ja: すべての光源には、そのまわりにわずかな闇の帯がある。人間にも見えるものだが、大抵は気づかないだけだ。

key: Rather than being drawn to light, the clever beauties try to hide from it in that null band, right under its proverbial nose.
en: Rather than being drawn to light, the clever beauties try to hide from it in that null band, right under its proverbial nose.
ja: 光にひかれるのではなく、あの賢い美しき者たちは、光の鼻先で、その帯の中に隠れようとしているのだよ。

key: It is as ironic as it is tragic that the very act of escaping that which they hate brings them close enough to be destroyed by it.
en: It is as ironic as it is tragic that the very act of escaping that which they hate brings them close enough to be destroyed by it.
ja: 憎むものから逃げようとする行為そのものが、破滅させられるほど近づく原因になる――皮肉であると同時に、悲劇的でもある。

key: But I suppose that means it suits you perfectly after all,
en: But I suppose that means it suits you perfectly after all,
ja: だが、それならこそ、お前にはお似合いというわけだ、

key: BENNETT: Doesn't it, \PN?
en: BENNETT: Doesn't it, \PN?
ja: ベネット: そうだろう、\PN?

key: HARDY: Oi, I didn't come here for a biology lesson, mate.
en: HARDY: Oi, I didn't come here for a biology lesson, mate.
ja: ハーディ: おい、生物の授業を受けに来たわけじゃねえんだよ、相棒。

key: BENNETT: That would be ethology, "mate".
en: BENNETT: That would be ethology, "mate".
ja: ベネット: それを言うなら「動物行動学」だな、「相棒」よ。

key: But that's just as well; I suspect such lessons would be lost on you anyhow.
en: But that's just as well; I suspect such lessons would be lost on you anyhow.
ja: まあ、どちらにせよ好都合だ。どうせお前にはそんな授業、猫に小判だろうからな。

key: BENNETT: \PN, you seem well.
en: BENNETT: \PN, you seem well.
ja: ベネット: \PN、元気そうだな。

key: I would like to apologize for my temperament when we last met; that was beyond disgraceful.
en: I would like to apologize for my temperament when we last met; that was beyond disgraceful.
ja: 前に会った時の私の態度については、わびておきたい。あれはあまりにも恥ずべきことだった。

key: Nevertheless, please be advised that I have made good on my prior promise.
en: Nevertheless, please be advised that I have made good on my prior promise.
ja: とはいえ、以前の約束はきちんと果たしたということを、知っておいてほしい。

key: You remember, right? What I promised?
en: You remember, right? What I promised?
ja: 覚えているだろう? 私が約束したこと。

key: BENNETT: By that, you of course mean yourself.
en: BENNETT: By that, you of course mean yourself.
ja: ベネット: もちろん、自分自身のことを言っているのだろう。

key: An expected, if arrogant, answer.
en: An expected, if arrogant, answer.
ja: 傲慢ではあるが、予想通りの答えだ。

key: But incorrect.
en: But incorrect.
ja: だが、間違っている。

key: Not everything is about you, \PN.
en: Not everything is about you, \PN.
ja: すべてがお前中心というわけではないのだ、\PN。

key: BENNETT: While it's true that that was my purpose back then, that is not what I promised.
en: BENNETT: While it's true that that was my purpose back then, that is not what I promised.
ja: ベネット: あの時それが目的だったのは事実だが、私が約束したのはそれではない。

key: She is a closed chapter in my life-- and one that should never have been opened.
en: She is a closed chapter in my life-- and one that should never have been opened.
ja: 彼女は、私の人生の中で既に閉じた章だ――そもそも開くべきではなかった章でもある。

key: BENNETT: So you do remember.
en: BENNETT: So you do remember.
ja: ベネット: ならば、覚えているのだな。

key: That is at once a source of pain and panacea, but I respect your acknowledgement.
en: That is at once a source of pain and panacea, but I respect your acknowledgement.
ja: それは苦痛であると同時に、万能薬でもある――だが、お前がそれを認めたことは尊重しよう。

key: BENNETT: That's fine.
en: BENNETT: That's fine.
ja: ベネット: それでいい。

key: To be frank, I would really rather all parties involved forget that any of that had ever happened.
en: To be frank, I would really rather all parties involved forget that any of that had ever happened.
ja: 率直に言えば、関わった者全員に、あの出来事など忘れてほしいくらいだ。

key: The thought of it now is gut-wrenching.
en: The thought of it now is gut-wrenching.
ja: 今それを考えるだけでも、はらわたが煮えくり返る。

key: In any case...
en: In any case...
ja: ともあれ……

key: I see you have the Bracelets, just as Lin said.
en: I see you have the Bracelets, just as Lin said.
ja: リンの言った通り、ブレスレットを持っているようだな。

key: Impressive.
en: Impressive.
ja: 見事だ。

key: HARDY: You know this tool, \PN?
en: HARDY: You know this tool, \PN?
ja: ハーディ: \PN、こいつのこと知ってんのか?

key: BENNETT: No.
en: BENNETT: No.
ja: ベネット: いや。

key: \PN does not know me.
en: \PN does not know me.
ja: \PNは私のことを知らない。

key: Not even I knew myself back then.
en: Not even I knew myself back then.
ja: あの頃は、私自身、自分のことすら知らなかったのだからな。

key: And I would appreciate not being called a tool by someone who has only been able to follow the most predictable set of actions.
en: And I would appreciate not being called a tool by someone who has only been able to follow the most predictable set of actions.
ja: それと、これ以上ないほど分かりやすい行動しか取れない人間に「道具」呼ばわりされたくはないものだな。

key: HARDY: What's that supposed to mean?
en: HARDY: What's that supposed to mean?
ja: ハーディ: どういう意味だよ、それ。

key: BENNETT: What, break the glass to get into a place?
en: BENNETT: What, break the glass to get into a place?
ja: ベネット: 何だ、ガラスを割って中に入る、という意味かな?

key: Don't make me sick; it's like my mother's Gym all over again.
en: Don't make me sick; it's like my mother's Gym all over again.
ja: うんざりさせないでくれ。母のジムの時と、まったく同じじゃないか。

key: But of course any dolt with a heavyweight Pokémon is going to try that.
en: But of course any dolt with a heavyweight Pokémon is going to try that.
ja: まあ、重量級のポケモンを連れた愚か者なら、誰でも試すことだろうがな。

key: HARDY: Yea, and it worked, didn't it?
en: HARDY: Yea, and it worked, didn't it?
ja: ハーディ: ああ、で、実際うまくいっただろ?

key: BENNETT: Did it?
en: BENNETT: Did it?
ja: ベネット: そうかな?

key: You don't think it's odd that your stone-tank Pokémon couldn't even break a few panes of glass?
en: You don't think it's odd that your stone-tank Pokémon couldn't even break a few panes of glass?
ja: お前の岩の戦車みたいなポケモンが、ガラス板の数枚すら割れなかったのを、おかしいとは思わないのか?

key: Or is it just that weak?
en: Or is it just that weak?
ja: それとも、単にそれだけ弱いということか?

key: HARDY: You wanna find out firsthand how weak it is?
en: HARDY: You wanna find out firsthand how weak it is?
ja: ハーディ: どれだけ弱いか、自分で確かめてみたいのか?

key: BENNETT: While intimidating and all, I'm afraid I must decline your typically brutish provocation.
en: BENNETT: While intimidating and all, I'm afraid I must decline your typically brutish provocation.
ja: ベネット: 脅しとしては大したものだが、あいにく、いかにもお前らしい野蛮な挑発は遠慮させてもらおう。

key: Unlike you, I've learned not to pick fights I know I can't win.
en: Unlike you, I've learned not to pick fights I know I can't win.
ja: お前と違って、私は勝てないと分かっているけんかは買わないと学んだのでな。

key: I may now be a member of the Elite Four, but even I know better than to go one against two,
en: I may now be a member of the Elite Four, but even I know better than to go one against two,
ja: 今でこそ四天王の一員ではあるが、それでも一対二で挑むほど愚かではない、

key: Especially when the two are a Rock-type specialist, and the golden child himself.
en: Especially when the two are a Rock-type specialist, and the golden child himself.
ja: 特にその二人が、いわタイプの専門家と、あの黄金の申し子となれば尚更だ。

key: Especially when the two are a Rock-type specialist, and the golden child herself.
en: Especially when the two are a Rock-type specialist, and the golden child herself.
ja: 特にその二人が、いわタイプの専門家と、あの黄金の申し子となれば尚更だ。

key: Especially when the two are a Rock-type specialist, and the golden child themselves.
en: Especially when the two are a Rock-type specialist, and the golden child themselves.
ja: 特にその二人が、いわタイプの専門家と、あの黄金の申し子となれば尚更だ。

key: Which brings us back to exactly my point.
en: Which brings us back to exactly my point.
ja: というわけで、まさに私の言いたかった話に戻るわけだ。

key: But I'll connect the dots for you, since you seem to have trouble doing that on your own.
en: But I'll connect the dots for you, since you seem to have trouble doing that on your own.
ja: とはいえ、自力では点と点をつなげないようだから、代わりにやってやろう。

key: That glass was reinforced with gossamer silk from an Ariados' web-- not that you could have noticed.
en: That glass was reinforced with gossamer silk from an Ariados' web-- not that you could have noticed.
ja: あのガラスはアリアドスの巣の糸で補強されていた――もっとも、お前に気づけたはずもないがな。

key: With that covering all but a single spot, there's only one entrance an intruding party would use.
en: With that covering all but a single spot, there's only one entrance an intruding party would use.
ja: たった一箇所を除いてすべて覆われていたから、侵入者が使える入り口は一つしかない。

key: And with that, we can be sure where any intruders will end up.
en: And with that, we can be sure where any intruders will end up.
ja: そうすれば、侵入者がどこに行き着くか、確実に分かるというわけだ。

key: HARDY: And so what? Just cuz you know we're here doesn't mean you can stop us!
en: HARDY: And so what? Just cuz you know we're here doesn't mean you can stop us!
ja: ハーディ: それがどうした? 俺たちがここにいると分かったところで、止められるとは限らねえぞ!

key: BENNETT: Oh, I'm not here to stop you.
en: BENNETT: Oh, I'm not here to stop you.
ja: ベネット: おや、止めるつもりなど毛頭ない。

key: I'm just here to make sure you arrived safely, and to tuck you in.
en: I'm just here to make sure you arrived safely, and to tuck you in.
ja: 私はただ、お前たちが無事に着いたことを確認して、寝かしつけに来ただけだ。

key: BENNETT: Nothing in particular.
en: BENNETT: Nothing in particular.
ja: ベネット: 特に何もないさ。

key: BENNETT: But it sure is a pity there's no sleep clause for reality.
en: BENNETT: But it sure is a pity there's no sleep clause for reality.
ja: ベネット: だが、現実には「おやすみ条項」がないとは、実に残念なことだ。

key: Sweet dreams.
en: Sweet dreams.
ja: よい夢を。

key: HARDY: Hey, what gives?! Get back here and fight!
en: HARDY: Hey, what gives?! Get back here and fight!
ja: ハーディ: おい、何のつもりだ?! 戻ってきて戦えよ!

key: Tch, the door's sealed.
en: Tch, the door's sealed.
ja: ちっ、ドアが封鎖されてる。

key: HARDY: Figures they'd try somethin' like...
en: HARDY: Figures they'd try somethin' like...
ja: ハーディ: こういう手を使ってくると思ったぜ……

key: Oh, stuff it. Not again--
en: Oh, stuff it. Not again--
ja: ああ、勘弁してくれ。また――

key: Out cold...
en: Out cold...
ja: ぐっすり眠り込んでいる……

key: Should Glaceon use Heal Bell?
en: Should Glaceon use Heal Bell?
ja: グレイシアに「いやしのすず」を使わせますか?

key: Your team was cured of status!
en: Your team was cured of status!
ja: 手持ちポケモンの状態異常が治った!

key: HARDY: ...
en: HARDY: ...
ja: ハーディ: ……

key: Ugh... \PN?
en: Ugh... \PN?
ja: うう……\PN?

key: Why are there five of you?
en: Why are there five of you?
ja: なんでお前が五人もいるんだ?

key: And you... have a herd of Glaceon...
en: And you... have a herd of Glaceon...
ja: それに、お前……グレイシアの群れを連れてるし……

key: Yo, I just had a dream with a Glaceon...
en: Yo, I just had a dream with a Glaceon...
ja: なあ、俺、グレイシアの出てくる夢を見たんだけどよ……

key: There was... A machine, and, like, an Eevee-lution King, and I don't remember how I got there, but...
en: There was... A machine, and, like, an Eevee-lution King, and I don't remember how I got there, but...
ja: なんか……機械があって、イーブイ進化系の王様みたいなのがいて、どうやってそこに行ったのかは覚えてねえけど……

key: All the Glaceon were like...
en: All the Glaceon were like...
ja: グレイシアたちがみんな、こう……

key: Tired...
en: Tired...
ja: 疲れてる感じで……

key: HARDY: ...Huh?
en: HARDY: ...Huh?
ja: ハーディ: ……あ?

key: ...Oh, right...
en: ...Oh, right...
ja: ……ああ、そうだ……

key: So the Eevee King was like... A really really big Dragon-type Eevee...
en: So the Eevee King was like... A really really big Dragon-type Eevee...
ja: で、イーブイの王様ってのはこう……めちゃくちゃでかいドラゴンタイプのイーブイでよ……

key: And you were totally there, \PN!
en: And you were totally there, \PN!
ja: で、\PN、お前もマジでそこにいたんだよ!

key: You like, appeared and were helping me fight it,
en: You like, appeared and were helping me fight it,
ja: なんか現れて、俺と一緒にそいつと戦ってくれてよ、

key: And all the other Eevees banded together with us... I think.
en: And all the other Eevees banded together with us... I think.
ja: 他のイーブイたちもみんな、俺たちと力を合わせてた……と思う。

key: But then it turned out the Eevee King was the one who got us there in the first place,
en: But then it turned out the Eevee King was the one who got us there in the first place,
ja: でも結局、そもそも俺たちをそこに連れてきたのがイーブイの王様自身でよ、

key: Like... Fighting the Eevee King was what it really wanted all along...
en: Like... Fighting the Eevee King was what it really wanted all along...
ja: なんつーか……イーブイの王様と戦うこと自体が、そいつがずっと望んでたことだったみたいで……

key: And even it was fighting itself with us...
en: And even it was fighting itself with us...
ja: それに、そいつ自身も、俺たちと一緒に自分自身と戦ってて……

key: Like a doppelganger or...
en: Like a doppelganger or...
ja: なんつーか、分身みたいな……

key: I dunno...
en: I dunno...
ja: よく分かんねえけど……

key: Yawnnnnn...
en: Yawnnnnn...
ja: ふわぁぁ……

key: HARDY: ...Hey, \PN, what's that chiming noise?
en: HARDY: ...Hey, \PN, what's that chiming noise?
ja: ハーディ: ……なあ\PN、そのチリンチリンって音、何だ?

key: You can turn it off, right...
en: You can turn it off, right...
ja: 止められるよな……

key: I'm tryna sleep here...
en: I'm tryna sleep here...
ja: こっちは寝ようとしてんだからよ……

key: HARDY: ...Just five more minutes, aite...?
en: HARDY: ...Just five more minutes, aite...?
ja: ハーディ: ……あと5分だけ、いいだろ……?

key: Or like, hours...
en: Or like, hours...
ja: ってか、5時間くらい……

key: None of the inputs seem to work...
en: None of the inputs seem to work...
ja: 何を入力しても反応がないようだ……

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: ロックされている。

key: Currently on: B2F
en: Currently on: B2F
ja: 現在階: 地下2階

key: Currently on: B1F
en: Currently on: B1F
ja: 現在階: 地下1階

key: Currently on: Ground Floor
en: Currently on: Ground Floor
ja: 現在階: 1階

key: Select floor.
en: Select floor.
ja: フロアを選択してください。

key: Ground Floor-- Now arrived.
en: Ground Floor-- Now arrived.
ja: 1階――到着しました。

key: B1F-- Now arrived.
en: B1F-- Now arrived.
ja: 地下1階――到着しました。

key: B2F-- Now arrived.
en: B2F-- Now arrived.
ja: 地下2階――到着しました。

key: To be stronger than anyone
en: To be stronger than anyone
ja: 誰よりも強くなるため

key: To win Luna
en: To win Luna
ja: ルナを勝ち取るため

key: To make things different
en: To make things different
ja: 何かを変えるため

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: Ground Floor
en: Ground Floor
ja: 1階

key: B1F
en: B1F
ja: 地下1階

key: B2F
en: B2F
ja: 地下2階
